label: Rounded Patch
description: The rounded lower patch pocket — called tasca a pignata by Neapolitan tailors — replaces the square corners of a standard patch pocket with a continuous curved lower edge and gently rounded corners. The curvature is wholly characteristic of Neapolitan tailoring, complementing the rounded cutaway fronts and soft construction those houses favour. A jacket with rounded patch pockets at the hip and a barchetta breast pocket is one of the most recognisable expressions of the Neapolitan canon.
